title: Passenger Door Controls
summary: Driver-operated controls to request passenger-door opening and closing.
purpose: Manage passenger-door operation at appropriate stops and observe door-secured feedback before movement.
observations: Opening, open, closing and closed are distinct door conditions.
All Doors Closed indicates that the monitored doors have completed closure.
Door-related interlocks can restrict traction until the relevant conditions are met.
interactions: Request opening at standstill when appropriate.
Request closing and observe the status through completion.
Check the required closed indication before requesting traction.
safetyNotes: Actual trains can have selective door-side enable, platform checks and other safety interlocks.
The teaching cab uses a simplified combined door-control arrangement.
